newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SOCCER-SPARTA PRAGUE TRYING TO SIGN MATTHAUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTA PRAGUE TRYING TO SIGN MATTHAUS.

text.p: Czech soccer champions Sparta Prague are trying to sign Bayern Munich's Germany midfielder Lothar Matthaus.
Sparta president Alexander Rezes told the Slovak daily Narodna Obroda on Tuesday: "We have established friendly contacts. I am convinced that we shall have a (positive) result."
Rezes, chairman of the board and the largest shareholder of giant Slovak steelmaker VSZ, bought Sparta a year ago in the name of VSZ for an estimated one billion crowns (about $30 million).
"We are eminently interested in pushing this deal through. We have had a first meeting," he added.
Rezes said in an interview with the official Slovak TASR news agency on Tuesday: "We want to turn Sparta into a mega-club of European class such as Bayern, Ajax (Amsterdam) or Juventus.
"We know this calls for...big players and big money which we are already putting into it," he added.
